doc: The bridge's action contract. Single source of truth: the panel (plugin/lib/spec.js is generated from it), the fake panel and the CLI are tested against it. Params are a JSON-Schema subset: type, required, default (documentation; handlers apply defaults), enum, minimum, maximum, minItems, items, properties (objects reject unknown keys), pairedWith, deprecated; requireOneOf at action level means at least one of the names is present (non-empty for arrays). An action with devOnly: true is a test that changes Premiere: only a dev build of the panel registers it (plugin/lib/build.js says dev: true in the repository, false in release exports and .ccx packages); a release build leaves it out of ping's actions and answers UNKNOWN_ACTION. No CLI command calls one.
outcomeRule: An explicit outcome wins; otherwise not_committed while the request committed nothing, else unknown. Read actions never report unknown.

guard.fingerprint: the timeline fingerprint get_sequence reports (items.fingerprint, 16 hex digits): checked on writes that are not dry runs, PRECONDITION_FAILED when the active sequence no longer has it; reads ignore it

UNKNOWN_ACTION.doc: The action is not in the panel's whitelist (a devOnly action counts as unknown on a release build).

BAD_PARAMS.doc: Missing, unknown or invalid params (checked against this spec before any handler runs), or a request that would put more than 1000 actions into one transaction (the panel's runaway guard; nothing is changed).

NO_SEQUENCE.doc: The project has no active sequence.

NOT_FOUND.doc: A project item, track, clip, component, param or transition was not found.

AMBIGUOUS.doc: Several project items or clips match; name one (bin path) or narrow the time.

PROJECT_MISMATCH.doc: The request's guard names another project (name, prefix or guid) than the active one.

SEQUENCE_MISMATCH.doc: The guard or --expect-seq names another sequence than the active one.

HOST_DENIED.doc: This Premiere build is on the panel's denylist; the panel answers ping only.

UNSUPPORTED.doc: This Premiere build lacks the capability, or the clip is not supported (e.g. speed != 1).

KEYFRAMED.doc: The param is already time-varying; a static value or new keyframes would be hidden or merged.

KEYFRAME_OUT_OF_RANGE.doc: A keyframe converts to a media time outside the clip's [in, out] (half a sequence frame tolerance).

NO_TRANSCRIPT.doc: The clip has no transcript (or only an empty placeholder).

TRANSCRIPT_EXISTS.doc: The clip already has a transcript with at least one word; pass replace (import) or remove it in Premiere.

TRANSCRIPT_NOT_IMPORTED.doc: The import transaction ran but the clip still has no words (a known Premiere bug on some builds).

TRANSCRIBE_RUNNING.doc: A Speech-to-Text job is running on this clip; wait for it.

TRANSCRIBE_FAILED.doc: Speech-to-Text was rejected at once (not_committed) or the job failed (unknown).

LANGUAGE_UNAVAILABLE.doc: The Speech-to-Text language pack is not installed (Premiere would show a modal prompt).

EXPORT_FAILED.doc: Premiere's exporter returned false or threw, or (CLI) it reported success but no file appeared.

TRANSACTION_FAILED.doc: executeTransaction (or Project#save) returned false (outcome by the side-effect rule).

INTERNAL.doc: Unexpected exception in a handler (outcome by the side-effect rule).

PANEL_STUCK.doc: A handler outlived its watchdog: refused requests are not_committed, the timed-out one is unknown. Save, then Reload the panel.

BRIDGE_BUSY.doc: The panel stayed busy past the queue timeout; the request was not sent. Safe to retry.

WRITE_LIMIT.doc: More writes in the broker's window than its limit allows (default 300 per 60 s, a guard against a runaway script); the request was not sent. Retry later, or raise PPRO_WRITE_LIMIT.

PANEL_TIMEOUT.doc: The panel did not answer in time; a write may still land (reads: not_committed).

BAD_REQUEST.doc: The request was not valid JSON or lacked id/action.

AUTH_FAILED.doc: The broker refused the pairing token (missing or wrong; a CLI older than 0.5 sends none). data.tokenFile says where the client looked; nothing reached Premiere.

TIMEOUT.doc: No reply from the broker in time (reads: not_committed).

CONNECTION_CLOSED.doc: The broker closed the connection after the request was sent (reads: not_committed).

BAD_REPLY.doc: The broker's reply was not JSON (reads: not_committed).

MISSING_DEPENDENCY.doc: A dependency is missing: Python packages (websockets, faster-whisper, Pillow) or ffmpeg/ffprobe on PATH (audio review).

NO_MEDIA.doc: The shadow mix (export_audio, review_cuts) cannot read a clip's media: no file path (Enhance Speech and other generated items) or the file is missing. data.clips lists them; use --render.

FILE_NOT_FOUND.doc: A local input file does not exist.

IO_ERROR.doc: A local file could not be read or written.

PANEL_OUTDATED.doc: The loaded panel lacks an action or its protocol is below the command's minProtocol: Reload it.

TRANSCRIPT_INVALID.doc: The transcript JSON fails the Adobe transcript schema check.

TRANSCRIBE_TIMEOUT.doc: --wait expired before the Speech-to-Text job finished; it may still finish.

TRANSCRIBE_LOST.doc: The job vanished from the panel's job table (panel reloaded); check hasTranscript.

NO_SPEECH.doc: Whisper produced no words; nothing was written.

CONFIRM_REQUIRED.doc: A destructive option needs its explicit confirmation flag.

NO_FREE_AUDIO_TRACK.doc: No audio track is free over the range; pass --atrack.

PRECONDITION_FAILED.doc: A read-back before writing did not match what the command expected, or the timeline no longer has the fingerprint the request was pinned to (guard.fingerprint, --expect-fingerprint), or a move would cross a clip: trim_clip moveTo passing over or onto another clip of its track (B1), shift_items running into a clip that stays.

CLIENT_GONE.doc: The client disconnected while its request waited for the panel; the broker dropped it unsent (nobody sees this reply).

VERIFY_FAILED.doc: A read-back after a write did not match what the command expected (partial when earlier steps landed; the panel reports it for remove_marker and clone_sequence).

TRANSITION_EXISTS.doc: The edit point already has a transition: Premiere would keep it and change nothing. data.existing names it; remove it first (remove_transition, or in Premiere), then add the new one.

IN_USE.doc: A project item to remove is still used in a sequence (Premiere would take those clips out of the sequence too); data.inUse lists where. Nothing was removed.

EXPORT_STALLED.doc: export_video saw no progress, no new panel event and no growth of the output file for --stall-seconds (default 180) and the file does not hold the whole sequence: the render may still finish (the project is untouched; the file may still be written). export_video --job <data.jobId> waits for it again.

EXPORT_RUNNING.doc: export_sequence while an export job of this panel is still rendering (or its exportSequence has not returned): one render at a time. data.jobId names it; wait for it (export_status, export_video --job), or Reload the panel if Premiere is no longer rendering.

EXPORT_LOST.doc: The export job vanished from the panel's job table while export_video waited (the panel was reloaded): Premiere may still be rendering to data.output; check the file before rendering again.

RENDER_CHECK_FAILED.doc: --render-check (split_clip, cut_range, extend_cut): the edit landed and was verified by list_items, but Premiere's render does not play a piece of it (silent, missing from the mix, a blank frame, or past the sequence end Premiere reports: the B1 symptoms), or the render could not run. data.renderCheck lists every piece; the hint says how to repair one.

mogrtText.doc: ppro.MogrtText (writing text is known-buggy on 27.0 betas)

fingerprintGuard.doc: The panel checks the guard key fingerprint (items.fingerprint of the active sequence) before a write that is not a dry run; transport.make_rpc refuses a fingerprint guard for a panel without it.

shiftItemsPrecise.doc: shift_items checks the room per track from where that track's first moving clip lands, and skips tracks with nothing to move (0.5 refused any staying clip ending after fromSeconds + deltaSeconds); editing.shift_items then sends one step instead of splitting tracks.

exportJobs.doc: export_sequence takes wait: false and returns a job at once (jobId, state); export_status reports it (state, progress, the encoder events that fired; only exportSequence's promise ends it). ops.export_video waits on the job without a time limit (stall detection only) when the panel advertises this, else renders in one request (600 s at most).

actions.name: ping
actions.doc: Liveness, version/protocol handshake, capabilities, features (panel behaviours a client may branch on, see features), stuck/denied state, build flavour (build.dev: false in a release or .ccx package, which registers no devOnly action).

probe.doc: Re-run the instance capability probe (skipped while stuck).

actions.name: get_project
actions.doc: Active project name, path, guid and active sequence name.

actions.name: get_sequence
actions.doc: Active sequence: frame size, timebase (ticks per frame), fps, duration, tracks, guid.

actions.name: set_active_sequence
actions.doc: Make another sequence of the active project the active one (opened in the Timeline), by exact name or guid, so the next requests work on it. Nothing in the project changes; read back after the switch.

name.doc: Exact sequence name (a name two sequences share is refused: AMBIGUOUS)

guid.doc: Sequence.guid, where the build has one

actions.name: select_items
actions.doc: Select clips in the Timeline (Sequence#setSelection), replacing the selection: on the given tracks, the clip under atSeconds, or the clips in [fromSeconds, toSeconds] (mode inside, the default: entirely inside; overlap: touching it). Only those clips: Premiere's linked partners are not added. clear: true empties the selection instead. For what only Premiere's own panels do (Properties > Enhance Audio applies to every selected clip); nothing in the project changes and it is not an undo step. Read back (after, verified).

atSeconds.doc: Sequence seconds: the one clip under this time on each track

mode.doc: For a range: inside = clips entirely in it; overlap = every clip touching it

clear.doc: Empty the selection (no tracks or times with it)

dryRun.doc: List the clips that would be selected; change nothing

errorExamples.doc: atSeconds or a range, not both
clear takes no tracks or times
no clip entirely inside the range (mode overlap would take the one crossing it)

actions.name: list_items
actions.doc: Clips on the active sequence's tracks: start/end (sequence s), inPoint/outPoint (source s).

actions.name: inspect_items
actions.doc: Effect chains (components with occurrence, params, values, keyframes in media time) and transitions of video clips; audio clips' chains on request.

audioTracks.doc: Audio tracks to include (default none); their chains hold Volume, Channel Volume, Panner

actions.name: list_project_items
actions.doc: Project panel clips with bin path and media path.

actions.name: export_frame
actions.doc: Write one frame of the program output as an image file.

errorExamples.doc: required strings must not be empty
the exporter cannot write into a missing folder
a network path as a folder
name is a plain file name: no folder

actions.name: export_otio
actions.doc: Export the active sequence as OpenTimelineIO JSON.

errorExamples.doc: required strings must not be empty
\\?\UNC\ is a network path too (\\?\<drive>:\ is a local long path and is fine)

actions.name: list_transcripts
actions.doc: Project clips with bin and hasTranscript, plus the panel's Speech-to-Text jobs.

jobsOnly.doc: Only the Speech-to-Text job table (no project walk)

actions.name: export_transcript
actions.doc: A clip's transcript as Adobe transcript JSON (string).

itemName.doc: Default: the first clip with a transcript

errorExamples.doc: same name, different media: pass binPath

actions.name: import_transcript
actions.doc: Attach an Adobe-format transcript to a clip and verify it by exporting it back (word counts).

errorExamples.doc: the transaction ran but the clip has no words (here: the doc has none)
required strings must not be empty

actions.name: transcribe_clip
actions.doc: Start Premiere Speech-to-Text on one clip and return at once; poll list_transcripts {jobsOnly: true}.

language.doc: Premiere code such as en-US (case-insensitive, from querySupportedLanguages); Premiere's auto-detect preference overrides it

errorExamples.doc: fake: the ko-KR pack is not installed (PPRO_FAKE_MISSING_LANGS)

actions.name: import_media
actions.doc: Import files into the project root or a top-level bin; reports the new item names.

errorExamples.doc: a network (UNC) path: Windows would offer the user's credentials to that host

actions.name: insert_clip
actions.doc: Place a project item, or a source range of it, on the active sequence (range: three undo steps).

errorExamples.doc: inSeconds and outSeconds come as a pair
the bridge never adds a track
required strings must not be empty

actions.name: set_scale
actions.doc: Motion > Scale on the clips of one video track overlapping [fromSeconds, toSeconds]; keyframed Scale is refused.

actions.name: set_params
actions.doc: Write effect params on the one clip under atSeconds (video, or audio for existing components such as Volume); everything is validated before the first transaction. Missing video effects are added in request order: appended, or on a graphic (a chain with AE.ADBE Graphic Group) right before its first layer component (Text, Shape: neither a top intrinsic, an addable filter nor an effect container), since an effect after the layers does nothing; a graphic just placed gets up to 2 s for its layers (layerWait; still none: appended, with a warning).

videoTrack.doc: Video track (exactly one of videoTrack / audioTrack)

occurrence.doc: n-th instance in chain order; missing instances are appended (on a graphic: before its layer components)

interpolation.doc: Temporal interpolation of the keyframes given, or alone, of every keyframe the param already has: linear, hold, bezier, time... (Constants.InterpolationMode) or Premiere's number 0-8; read back per key

audioTrack.doc: Audio track: write params of components the audio clip already has (e.g. Volume)

dryRun.doc: Validate the whole request (missing effects are created as factory components, nothing is added; createdComponents gives their planned indexes) and commit nothing; replace_clip asks this before removing a clip

errorExamples.doc: Motion and Opacity exist once per clip
a param needs a value or keyframes
media time past 9 h is a unit mistake
more than 16 effect instances to add
a second volume instance would be an added effect
the volume component has params 0 (bypass) and 1 (Level)

actions.name: list_transition_names
actions.doc: Video transition match names available in Premiere.

actions.name: add_transition
actions.doc: Add a video transition at the start or end of the clip under atSeconds. added = the track has one more transition than before: Premiere keeps a transition already at that edit point, and transition items expose no times over UXP (read them from export_otio).

errorExamples.doc: required strings must not be empty

actions.name: remove_transition
actions.doc: Remove the video transition at the start or end edge of the clip under atSeconds (one undo step). Transition items expose no times over UXP, so the panel reads the track's transition count, strictly, before and after: a track without transitions is NOT_FOUND before anything changes, and a removal that leaves the count unchanged is NOT_FOUND too (not_committed). When the clip's own call removes nothing and one clip touches that edge, the neighbour's opposite edge is asked (via: neighbour, one more undo step). ops.remove_transition finds the transition in an OTIO export first and verifies it is gone.

edge.doc: The edit point at the clip's start or end

dryRun.doc: Find the clip, its neighbour at that edge and the track's transition count; change nothing (wouldRefuse: NOT_FOUND when the track has no transitions)

actions.name: remove_effect
actions.doc: Remove one added component (filter) from the chain of the clip under atSeconds (one undo step), addressed by match name and occurrence like set_params. The components built into every clip (Motion, Opacity, Time Remapping, an audio clip's Internal volume components) are refused (UNSUPPORTED). Read back: chain must be chainBefore without exactly that instance (verified).

videoTrack.doc: Video track (exactly one of videoTrack / audioTrack)

audioTrack.doc: Audio track (exactly one of videoTrack / audioTrack)

occurrence.doc: n-th instance of matchName in chain order (inspect_items lists it)

dryRun.doc: Find the component and change nothing (wouldRefuse: NOT_FOUND when the clip lacks it)

errorExamples.doc: required strings must not be empty

actions.name: remove_keyframes
actions.doc: Remove keyframes of one param of the clip under atSeconds (one undo step): all of them, or those between fromSeconds and toSeconds in a timeBase (converted like set_params' keyframes; the range may reach past the clip). When every keyframe goes, animation is switched off (animationOff) and valueAfter says which value Premiere kept; keepValue sets the value the param had at the middle of the clip instead. No keyframes there is NOT_FOUND before anything changes. Read back: remaining (and the kept value) -> verified.

videoTrack.doc: Video track (exactly one of videoTrack / audioTrack)

audioTrack.doc: Audio track (exactly one of videoTrack / audioTrack)

occurrence.doc: n-th instance of matchName in chain order

all.doc: Every keyframe (animation off); or give fromSeconds / toSeconds

fromSeconds.doc: Range start in timeBase (inclusive, 1 us of slack)

toSeconds.doc: Range end in timeBase (inclusive, 1 us of slack)

timeBase.doc: Required with fromSeconds / toSeconds: media (what inspect_items reports), clip, sequence

keepValue.doc: When every keyframe goes: keep the value the param had at the middle of the clip

dryRun.doc: List the keyframes that would go and stay; change nothing (wouldRefuse: NOT_FOUND when there are none)

errorExamples.doc: media time past 9 h is a unit mistake

actions.name: set_fps
actions.doc: Interpret footage: override the frame rate of project items (affects every sequence using them).

errorExamples.doc: an ambiguous reference wins over a missing one

actions.name: subclip
actions.doc: A subclip of a project item (source in/out on the item's frames, hard boundaries, video and/or audio) in a bin: one undo step (a missing top-level bin is created in it), two when Premiere puts the subclip in another bin and it is moved. A clip of that name already in the target bin is refused (PRECONDITION_FAILED) unless allowDuplicateName. Read back: the new item, its bin and its own in/out point.

binPath.doc: The source item's bin when names repeat ("" = root)

inSeconds.doc: Source in point in seconds (the CLI snaps it to the item's frames)

outSeconds.doc: Source out point in seconds, after inSeconds and within the media

bin.doc: Target bin path (default: the source item's bin; "" = root); a missing top-level bin is created in the same undo step

allowDuplicateName.doc: Make it even when the target bin already has a clip of that name

dryRun.doc: Check everything and say where it would land (frameRate, mediaSeconds); change nothing

errorExamples.doc: a clip of that name is already in the target bin (the source's)
an EN and a CN item share the name
only a missing top-level bin is created
past the end of the 12 s media

actions.name: relink
actions.doc: Point a project item at another media file (changeMediaFilePath with the compatibility override, then refreshMedia) and read its media path back. Every sequence using the item follows (uses: clips per sequence; sameMedia: other items on the old file). Not an undo step: relink back to previousPath. Refused for sequences, ambiguous names, items Premiere cannot relink (canChangeMediaPath) and a running Speech-to-Text job; the CLI checks and compares the files first.

binPath.doc: Its bin when names repeat ("" = root); any second item of that name needs it

newPath.doc: Absolute path of the new media file (the CLI checks it exists, is no UNC path or data stream, and matches the old media)

dryRun.doc: Report the item's current media facts, its uses and sameMedia; change nothing

errorExamples.doc: relinking changes one item: name it with its bin
a device path (\\.\): no media lives there

actions.name: add_marker
actions.doc: Add a sequence marker (remove_marker takes one off again).

errorExamples.doc: required strings must not be empty

actions.name: list_markers
actions.doc: The active sequence's markers in start order: guid (26.3+), name, comments, start / duration / end (sequence s), type and colorIndex. A marker list that cannot be read is an error, never an empty list.

actions.name: remove_marker
actions.doc: Remove ONE sequence marker by guid, or by exact name (atSeconds narrows a name several markers share). No match (NOT_FOUND) or several (AMBIGUOUS) is refused before anything changes. One undo step; read back afterwards (still there: VERIFY_FAILED, committed).

atSeconds.doc: The marker's start in sequence seconds (half a frame of tolerance), when several markers share the name

dryRun.doc: Name the marker that would go; change nothing

errorExamples.doc: an empty name counts as none

actions.name: list_sequences
actions.doc: Every sequence of the active project: name, guid, active, and restorePoint (the record clone_sequence tagged it with: sourceGuid, sourceName, created, renamed; null for any other sequence).

actions.name: clone_sequence
actions.doc: A restore point before a risky edit: clone the active sequence (or the one named by guid / name), rename the clone "<name> [restore YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM]" and tag it with a sequence custom property (2 undo steps; not made active). Then delete the oldest restore points of the same source beyond keep (Project#deleteSequence; only tagged ones, never the active one or one the user renamed). A clone that cannot be found, named or tagged afterwards is VERIFY_FAILED (committed).

name.doc: Exact name of the sequence to clone (default: the active one)

guid.doc: Guid of the sequence to clone (wins over name)

keep.doc: Restore points of that sequence to keep, the new one included; older ones are deleted

dryRun.doc: The clone's name and what pruning would delete; change nothing

errorExamples.doc: the new restore point always stays

actions.name: save_project
actions.doc: Save the active project (Project#save, a direct call: not an undo step). Reports the project path; the CLI compares the file's time stamp before and after.

errorExamples.doc: no Save As: unknown params are refused

actions.name: remove_items
actions.doc: Remove clips in a range (default: only clips entirely inside); ripple closes the gap.

actions.name: remove_project_items
actions.doc: Remove bins and/or project items from the project (one undo step; media files stay on disk). Refused when a sequence still uses an item (IN_USE) or a sequence would go with them (UNSUPPORTED); every sequence is read strictly first. Read back afterwards (remaining).

bins.doc: Bin paths ("Bin" or "Bin/Sub bin"); everything inside goes too. The root bin cannot be removed

items.doc: Project items (clips); a name that matches more than one item needs its binPath

dryRun.doc: List what would go, where it is used, and wouldRefuse; change nothing

errorExamples.doc: an EN and a CN item share the name

actions.name: clone_clip
actions.doc: Clone the one clip under atSeconds offsetSeconds later (keeps its effects, volume and scaling); overwrites the destination; linked items are not cloned with it. The building block of split_clip / cut_range.

offsetSeconds.doc: Seconds later (negative: earlier) the copy starts

trackOffset.doc: Tracks up (negative: down) of the same kind; the destination must exist

errorExamples.doc: the destination track must exist (never added)

actions.name: trim_clip
actions.doc: Trim or move the one clip under atSeconds: start / end (sequence s) and inPoint / outPoint (source s) are head / tail trims with the content anchored to the timeline (measured on 27.1); moveTo = absolute new start, alone, refused when the move would pass over or land on another clip of the track (B1: such a move renders silent or blank); one undo step, read back.

start.doc: New sequence start: a head trim (the in point moves by the same delta; end stays)

end.doc: New sequence end: a tail trim (the out point moves by the same delta; start stays)

inPoint.doc: New source in point: also a head trim (start moves by the same delta; end stays)

outPoint.doc: New source out point: a tail trim (end moves by the same delta; start stays)

moveTo.doc: New sequence start, length and source range kept; not combinable with the other fields; refused (PRECONDITION_FAILED) when the path from the old to the new place crosses another clip of the track by more than half a frame

errorExamples.doc: needs start, end, inPoint, outPoint or moveTo
moveTo is never combined with trims

actions.name: export_sequence
actions.doc: Render the active sequence to a file inside Premiere with an encoder preset (e.g. Premiere's WAV preset: a 67 s sequence takes ~1.5 s); the project is not changed. wait false: start an export job and reply once it ended, or after 1 s with state running (poll export_status); a job ends only when exportSequence's promise settles (false within that second is EXPORT_FAILED and no job); one render at a time.

presetPath.doc: An .epr encoder preset, e.g. Premiere's own MediaIO/systempresets/3F3F3F3F_57415645/Waveform Audio 48kHz 16-bit.epr (the CLI finds it)

workAreaOnly.doc: Render only the work area (default: the whole sequence)

wait.doc: true: the request lasts as long as the render (timeoutSeconds 600). false: an export job (feature exportJobs); the reply carries jobId and state

errorExamples.doc: a job refused at once (exportSequence returned false) is no job: EXPORT_FAILED as with wait
the preset is opened by Premiere too

actions.name: export_status
actions.doc: Export jobs of this panel (export_sequence wait false), each {jobId, state: running | done | failed | cancelled, progress (0-1 or null), progressRaw, elapsedSeconds, outputPath, preset, workAreaOnly, sequence, startedAt, finishedAt, lastEventAt, endEvent (the last complete / error / cancel / exportMediaComplete event: {type, at, message, state?}), error, settledBy ("promise": exportSequence's promise is the only thing that ends a job; the encoder and project events are not tied to one render), returned (what exportSequence returned: true, false, "threw", null while pending), pending, events (count per type: progress, complete, error, cancel, queue, exportMediaComplete), routes (events per listener route), eventKeys / eventSample (keys and primitive values of each type's first event), listeners, listenerErrors}. Makes no Premiere call and checks no guard (like ping: it touches no project or sequence); a panel reload forgets its jobs.

jobId.doc: Only this job (NOT_FOUND when the panel does not know it); omitted: every job

errorExamples.doc: unknown job (or the panel was reloaded since)

actions.name: list_effects
actions.doc: The effects Premiere can add: video filters with match name and display name (VideoFilterFactory; the pairing by list position is spot-checked by creating a few, which commits nothing) and audio filters by their localised display name only (AudioFilterFactory lists no match names; one shows in inspect_items once the effect is on a clip).

kind.doc: Only audio or only video effects (default both)

actions.name: add_audio_effect
actions.doc: Append an audio effect to the one audio clip under atSeconds, by its display name as Premiere lists it (localised: the UI language) or by the match name of one; one undo step, read back (verified: the chain has one more component, with that name). An unknown name is refused with the closest names (data.closeNames) before anything changes.

name.doc: A display name from list_effects (exact; case is ignored when that is unambiguous), or a match name (a GUID or "AE.ADBE ..."), looked up by creating each listed effect (commits nothing)

dryRun.doc: Resolve the name and the clip and report the chain; change nothing

errorExamples.doc: not an audio effect Premiere lists (data.closeNames)

actions.name: shift_items
actions.doc: Shift every clip starting at or after fromSeconds on the given tracks by deltaSeconds in one undo step (the sync-keeping ripple after a cut); a left shift needs the room on each track: a clip that stays must end before where that track's first moving clip lands (tracks with nothing to move are left alone).

fromSeconds.doc: Clips starting at or after this (half a frame tolerance) move

deltaSeconds.doc: Seconds to move them by (negative: left, which needs the room free)

errorExamples.doc: the interview (0-60 s) would start at -5 s, before 0 s

actions.name: probe_api
actions.doc: Inventory of the UXP API this Premiere build offers: every premierepro export (classes with static and prototype members, namespaces with their enum values), the uxp module's exports (types only), and the members of real instances (project, sequence, editor, tracks, clips, chains, markers, bins, encoder). Getters are listed, never called; no Action is created. Members: "name(arity)" a method, "name{get,set}" an accessor, "name:type" a data property.

instances.doc: Also list members of real instances (needs an open project)

actions.name: api_smoke
actions.doc: Test harness, not an editing command: one fixed case that exercises UXP calls Adobe documents but the bridge has never run (tests/live/api_smoke.py runs them all). Refused with PRECONDITION_FAILED unless the active project's name starts with PAB_TEST or equals allowProject (a project the user named for this run). Each step reports pass / fail / absent / error / skipped; the case puts back what it changed and lists what it could not in leftovers. Dev builds only (devOnly): a release panel does not register it.

videoTrack.doc: Track of the scratch clip (0 = V1)

audioTrack.doc: Track of the scratch clip's audio (0 = A1)

atSeconds.doc: A sequence time inside the scratch clip

itemName.doc: Project item for project_items / relink / source_monitor / implicit_track

copyPath.doc: relink: a copy of itemName's media file

outputDir.doc: converter_exports: folder for the XML and AAF files

displayName.doc: audio_filter: an audio effect display name (localised)

keepMogrt.doc: mogrt: leave the inserted clips in place (a live test of effects on a graphic; take them off with remove_items)

allowTrackAdd.doc: implicit_track: allow adding tracks (no API removes them)

binName.doc: cleanup_bin: the runner's bin (must start with PAB_API_)

allowProject.doc: The exact name of one project outside PAB_TEST* the user agreed to test in

allowAaf.doc: converter_exports: also export an AAF (Premiere may block on a modal export log)

errorExamples.doc: the case needs the scratch clip (videoTrack, atSeconds)

commands.name: ping
commands.doc: Liveness + version/protocol handshake; warns when panel, broker or CLI differ

commands.name: get_project
commands.doc: Active project name, path, guid and active sequence name

commands.name: get_sequence
commands.doc: Active sequence: frame size, fps, duration, tracks (name, clip count), player position, guid, and the timeline's fingerprint for --expect-fingerprint

commands.name: set_active_sequence
commands.doc: Switch the active sequence by name or guid (opens it in the Timeline) so later commands work on it; the project's content is unchanged

commands.name: select_items
commands.doc: Select clips in the Timeline (the clip under --at, or those in --from/--to) for Premiere's own panels, e.g. Properties > Enhance Audio on every selected clip; --clear empties it; read back

commands.name: list_items
commands.doc: Clips on the timeline: start/end (sequence s), in/out (source s), project item, media path

commands.name: inspect_items
commands.doc: Each clip's effect chain (components with occurrence, param values, keyframes in media time) and the transitions; --output saves it

commands.name: list_project_items
commands.doc: Project panel clips with bin path and media path

commands.name: export_frame
commands.doc: One frame of the program output as an image (default: the sequence frame size); the real path is in resolvedPath. A time at or past the sequence end is refused (Premiere would export the 0 s frame)

commands.name: export_frames
commands.doc: Several frames, optionally a contact sheet (Pillow); times at or past the sequence end are refused before any export

commands.name: export_otio
commands.doc: Timeline structure as OpenTimelineIO JSON, including each clip's source media path and the transitions

commands.name: list_transcripts
commands.doc: Every project clip with hasTranscript, plus the panel's Speech-to-Text jobs (--jobs: only the job table)

commands.name: list_transition_names
commands.doc: Video transition match names this Premiere offers, for add_transition

commands.name: export_transcript
commands.doc: Save a clip's Premiere transcript JSON (--item name or bin/name; default: the first clip with one)

commands.name: import_transcript
commands.doc: Check a transcript file locally, attach it to a clip and verify it by word count (--replace overwrites one)

commands.name: transcribe_clip
commands.doc: Premiere Speech-to-Text (26.5+): start, poll, export

commands.name: import_media
commands.doc: Import files into the root or a top-level bin (created if missing); returns the new item names

commands.name: add_marker
commands.doc: Sequence marker with name, comment, duration and colour (fact-check flags, notes for the editor)

commands.name: list_markers
commands.doc: The active sequence's markers: guid, name, comments, start / duration (sequence s), type, colour index and colour name

commands.name: remove_marker
commands.doc: Remove one sequence marker by guid, or by name (+ --at when several share it); refused when none or several match; one undo step, read back

commands.name: list_sequences
commands.doc: Every sequence in the project: name, guid, active flag, and whether it is a bridge restore point

commands.name: clone_sequence
commands.doc: A restore point before risky edits: clone a sequence, name and tag the clone, delete the oldest restore points of it beyond --keep

commands.name: save_project
commands.doc: Save the project (Project#save) and check that the project file's time stamp changed

commands.name: insert_clip
commands.doc: Place a project item, or only a source range of it (--in/--out), at a sequence time on existing tracks

commands.name: set_scale
commands.doc: Motion > Scale per clip: a percent, or fit/fill computed from the media size (ffprobe); a range takes only clips entirely inside it unless --mode overlap; keyframed Scale is refused

commands.name: set_fps
commands.doc: Interpret footage: override items' frame rate (changes them in every sequence); --dry-run lists the uses

commands.name: subclip
commands.doc: A subclip of a project item (source seconds snapped to its frames) in a bin, read back; refuses a name already in that bin unless --allow-duplicate-name

commands.name: relink
commands.doc: Point a project item at another media file after checking it matches the old one (ffprobe: duration, fps, streams; --force skips); read back, uses listed

commands.name: remove_items
commands.doc: Remove clips in a range (default: only clips entirely inside); --ripple closes the gap and reports what moved

commands.name: remove_project_items
commands.doc: Remove bins and project items from the project in one undo step (media files stay on disk); refused while a sequence uses an item

commands.name: apply_plan
commands.doc: Execute a JSON edit plan (B-roll, graphics, notes): imports, placements, scale and markers, verified by read-back

commands.name: replace_clip
commands.doc: Replace With Clip, keeping source range, effect params, keyframes, added filters and edge transitions; verified

commands.name: set_params
commands.doc: Effect params and keyframes (timeBase media, clip or sequence) on the clip under a time, from a JSON file

commands.name: set_volume
commands.doc: Clip volume in dB (Volume > Level, as Premiere shows it) on the audio clip under a time, or on the clips entirely inside a range (--mode overlap: every clip touching it); verified

commands.name: add_transition
commands.doc: A video transition at the start or end of the clip under a time, snapped to whole frames; refused where the edit point already has one, read back from OTIO

commands.name: remove_transition
commands.doc: Remove the video transition at the start or end of the clip under a time (one undo step): found in an OTIO export first (NOT_FOUND when none, owner = which clip it lies on), verified gone afterwards

commands.name: remove_effect
commands.doc: Remove one added effect (filter, by match name and occurrence) from the clip under a time, in one undo step; built-in components are refused; the chain is read back

commands.name: remove_keyframes
commands.doc: Remove keyframes of one effect param on the clip under a time: a time range (media, clip or sequence seconds) or all of them (animation off, optionally keeping the clip's middle value); read back

commands.name: split_clip
commands.doc: Split the clip under a time without a razor (clone + trim + clone back, no move across clips); both halves keep every clip attribute; --render-check renders afterwards and checks both pieces play

commands.name: cut_range
commands.doc: Remove a time range from all tracks and close the gap on every track by the same amount (sync kept, attributes kept); --render-check renders afterwards and checks every piece it split, trimmed or moved plays

commands.name: extend_cut
commands.doc: Open up a cut (breathing room) with more of the clips' own source; everything after it moves right on every track in one step; --render-check renders afterwards and checks every clip it extended or moved plays

commands.name: snap_edges
commands.doc: Put clip edges that drifted microseconds off the frame grid back on it, so the picture cuts on the same frame as the sound

commands.name: shift_items
commands.doc: Move every clip at/after a time on all tracks (or the chosen ones) by whole frames in one undo step, keeping them in sync

commands.name: conform_captions
commands.doc: Trim pre-rendered caption pieces to SRT line boundaries so no line flashes in or is cut a few frames in

commands.name: review_cuts
commands.doc: Listening report: breathing room, clipped words, room-tone jumps and clicks at every dialogue cut, plus the timeline lint

commands.name: lint_timeline
commands.doc: Slivers, cuts too close together, gaps and overlaps, A/V cut mismatches and clips past the end of the active sequence

commands.name: export_audio
commands.doc: The sequence audio as a WAV for analysis: a shadow mix of the source files, or Premiere's own render

commands.name: list_presets
commands.doc: Encoder presets (.epr) on disk: Premiere's system presets next to the running executable and the user's own (Adobe Media Encoder's Presets folders), with the format each writes; no panel needed

commands.name: export_video
commands.doc: Render the active sequence with an encoder preset (name or .epr path) and check the file with ffprobe: frame size, frame rate and length against the sequence; on a panel with exportJobs the render is a job polled without a time limit (--detach / --job)

commands.name: list_effects
commands.doc: Effects Premiere can add: video filters (match and display name) and audio filters (localised display name)

commands.name: add_audio_effect
commands.doc: Add an audio effect by its (localised) display name or match name to the audio clip under a time, in one undo step; verified by reading the chain back

commands.name: probe_api
commands.doc: Inventory of this Premiere build's UXP API (classes, methods, instance members); --output saves it, --diff compares with an earlier dump, and a watch list says which calls the port depends on are there

commands.name: list_effect_presets
commands.doc: Effect presets (.prfpset) on disk: Premiere's own (Factory, Lumetri; in its UI language) and the user's, with bin path, effects, animation and whether apply_preset can replay them; ping and list_effects only when the bridge answers

commands.name: apply_preset
commands.doc: Apply an effect preset (.prfpset) to the clip under a time or the clips in a range by translating it to set_params (keyframes in clip time per the preset's anchoring); what UXP cannot write is skipped and reported; verified
